title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
title_es: Google hace la IA privada práctica con cifrado homomórfico
bajada: Google avanza en el uso de cifrado homomórfico para permitir que los modelos de IA procesen datos sin descifrarlos. Esta técnica es clave para entrenar y usar IA en datos sensibles sin comprometer la privacidad.
bajada_en: Google advances homomorphic encryption to enable AI models to process data without decrypting it. This technique is crucial for training and using AI on sensitive data while maintaining privacy.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
summary: US groups release cheaper models after new challenges to their trillion-dollar ambitions.
title_es: Guerra de precios entre OpenAI y Anthropic ante presión de rivales chinos
bajada: OpenAI y Anthropic lanzan modelos más económicos en respuesta a la competencia de startups de IA chinas. Este movimiento marca un cambio en la estrategia de precios del sector tras nuevos desafíos a sus ambiciones millonarias.
bajada_en: OpenAI and Anthropic launch cheaper models in response to competition from Chinese AI startups. This shift marks a pricing strategy change in the sector following new challenges to their billion-dollar ambitions.

title_es: Meta lanza Glimmer, modelo abierto que desafía su filosofía cerrada
bajada: Meta liberó Glimmer, un modelo de IA de peso abierto descargable y ejecutable localmente, alineado con la declaración de Mark Zuckerberg sobre IA para todos. Contrasta con Muse Spark, su modelo más poderoso que mantiene tras APIs privadas.
bajada_en: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model downloadable and runnable locally, aligned with Mark Zuckerberg's statement about AI for everyone. It contrasts with Muse Spark, its more powerful model locked behind private APIs.

title: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
summary: When Twitch announced that streamers could opt out, thousands of users questioned why their content was being used to train AI models in the first place.
title_es: Amazon usa contenido de Twitch para entrenar IA, permite opt-out
bajada: Amazon utilizará contenido de streamers de Twitch para entrenar modelos de IA, pero permite que usuarios se excluyan. Miles de streamers cuestionan por qué sus datos se usan sin consentimiento previo explícito.
bajada_en: Amazon will use Twitch streamer content to train AI models but allows users to opt out. Thousands of streamers question why their data is used without explicit prior consent.

title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
summary: Apple has reportedly trained a custom AI model for the China market alongside domestic tech giant Alibaba, a rare cross-border partnership that cuts across growing tensions between Beijing and Washington. The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company's support, Reuters reports, citing three unnamed people familiar with […]
title_es: Apple entrena modelo de IA propio en China con Alibaba
bajada: Apple desarrolló un modelo de lenguaje personalizado para China en asociación con Alibaba, una colaboración inusual entre empresas occidentales y chinas. El movimiento refleja la necesidad de cumplir requisitos regulatorios locales en el mercado chino.
bajada_en: Apple developed a custom language model for China in partnership with Alibaba, an unusual collaboration between Western and Chinese companies. The move reflects the need to meet local regulatory requirements in the Chinese market.

title: Aug 14, 2026AnnouncementsHow Claude’s text watermark works
summary: Announcements How Claude’s text watermark works Aug 14, 2026 Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act. In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change. To summarize: We use a method of watermarking that does not have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs; The difference between watermarked and un-watermarked text will not be distinguishable to readers; Nothing is added to the text and there are no hidden characters; Watermarking doesn’t require extra tokens, and will not be more expensive; Watermarking carries no identifying information and can’t be traced to a specific person, organization, or chat; Watermarking won’t be specific to Claude. As of August 2, the EU requires AI providers serving its market to mark AI-generated content. Other major model developers have signed the same Code of Practice and will be implementing their own watermarks. What is watermarking? Large language models like Claude work by generating one word at a time. Each time the model decides on the next word, it chooses among a list of potential candidates, ultimately selecting the most sensible or likely based on the preceding text. Take the sentence “The weather today was cold and…”. The next word is very unlikely to be “sugary.” But it is quite likely to be “overcast” or “grey.” Under most circumstances, it doesn’t matter much to the reader which of these latter two words the model ultimately chooses—the meaning of the sentence is largely the same either way. title_es: Anthropic implementa marca de agua en texto de Claude por regulación EU
bajada: Anthropic añade watermarking invisible a textos generados por Claude para cumplir con la EU AI Act. El método no afecta calidad ni costo, permitiendo identificar contenido generado por IA sin impacto en usuarios.
bajada_en: Anthropic adds invisible watermarking to Claude-generated text to comply with the EU AI Act. The method doesn't affect quality or cost, allowing AI-generated content identification without user impact.

The release landed alongside a letter from Mark Zuckerberg arguing AI should be “for everyone” rather than controlled by a handful of labs, but as Equity’s […]
title_es: Meta y su tensión entre IA abierta y modelos premium
bajada: El debate sobre la verdadera apertura de Meta continúa mientras la empresa negocia su estrategia entre modelos abiertos accesibles y soluciones propietarias. La narrativa de Zuckerberg genera cuestionamientos sobre los verdaderos alcances del compromiso.

title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
summary: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file.
title_es: Google permite remover marca de agua visible en generaciones de IA
bajada: Google actualiza Gemini y Flow para permitir a usuarios desactivar la marca de agua visible en contenido generado por IA. Google mantiene marcas invisibles para identificar archivos generados por IA.
bajada_en: Google updates Gemini and Flow to allow users to disable visible watermarks on AI-generated content. Google maintains invisible watermarks to identify AI-generated files.

title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
summary: Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With the update, you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow. When toggled off, Google will remove the "sparkle" watermark that appears in the bottom-right corner of […]
title_es: Gemini permite desactivar marcas de agua en imágenes y videos de IA
bajada: Google habilita la opción de remover la marca de agua "sparkle" en imágenes, videos y música generados por Gemini y Flow. La actualización da más control a usuarios sobre el marcado visual de contenido generado.
bajada_en: Google enables users to remove the 'sparkle' watermark from images, videos, and music generated by Gemini and Flow. The update gives users more control over visual marking of AI-generated content.

title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
summary: Indonesia is taking charge of its AI future. This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center. Established under Indonesia’s AI Center of […]
title_es: Indonesia abre primer centro de IA universitario con NVIDIA
bajada: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat y NVIDIA lanzaron el primer centro de tecnología de IA universitario en Indonesia. La iniciativa busca desarrollar talento local en IA bajo la estrategia de centros de IA del país.
bajada_en: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat, and NVIDIA launched Indonesia's first university-based AI technology center. The initiative aims to develop local AI talent under the country's AI centers strategy.

title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
summary: The idea that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows may be a misconception, according to French startup Kog.
title_es: Kog optimiza GPUs para mejorar inferencia en flujos agentic
bajada: La startup francesa Kog cuestiona la creencia de que GPUs son inadecuadas para workflows agentic, presentando soluciones para extraer más inferencia de hardware existente. El enfoque podría cambiar cómo se optimiza la ejecución de agentes de IA.
bajada_en: French startup Kog challenges the belief that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows, presenting solutions to squeeze more inference from existing hardware. The approach could change how AI agents are optimized.

title: Suspecting court of using AI, man injected prompts in filings to try to win case
title_es: Hombre inyecta prompts en documentos legales para vencer a IA judicial
bajada: Un litigante intentó inyectar prompts en documentos legales para manipular un sistema de IA que sospechaba estaba siendo usado por la corte. El caso ilustra vulnerabilidades de seguridad cuando sistemas de IA se usan en contextos críticos.
bajada_en: A litigant attempted to inject prompts into legal documents to manipulate an AI system he suspected the court was using. The case illustrates security vulnerabilities when AI systems are used in critical contexts.

title: Maximizing the value of your Claude Code sessions
title_es: Maximiza el valor de tus sesiones con Claude Code
bajada: Anthropic publica mejores prácticas para aprovechar Claude Code en tareas de programación. La guía busca ayudar a developers a obtener más valor de las capacidades de asistencia de código.
bajada_en: Anthropic publishes best practices to maximize Claude Code for programming tasks. The guide aims to help developers get more value from code assistance capabilities.

title: Show HN: ThoughtDAG – An editable context graph for LLM conversations
title_es: ThoughtDAG: Grafo de contexto editable para conversaciones LLM
bajada: Un proyecto muestra una interfaz editable que organiza conversaciones con LLMs como grafos acíclicos dirigidos. La herramienta mejora cómo los usuarios pueden visualizar y controlar el contexto en diálogos complejos.
bajada_en: A project showcases an editable interface that organizes LLM conversations as directed acyclic graphs. The tool improves how users can visualize and control context in complex dialogues.

title: HashAgent – Share an AI agent as a URL, runs locally via WebGPU
title_es: HashAgent: Comparte agentes de IA como URL ejecutables localmente
bajada: HashAgent permite compartir agentes de IA como URLs que se ejecutan localmente en navegadores mediante WebGPU. La solución simplifica la distribución de agentes sin infraestructura centralizada.
bajada_en: HashAgent allows sharing AI agents as URLs that run locally in browsers via WebGPU. The solution simplifies agent distribution without centralized infrastructure.
